about.title: About Salazar & Velazquez
text: The lawyers at Salazar & Velazquez, P.C. focus on getting real results for their clients and families. Our firm was built on a culture of trust, success, and experience. The Salazar & Velazquez, P.C. law firm represents families and individuals who have suffered minor and major injuries or death due to the negligence of others.
We are detail-oriented when we prepare for a case and are strict when it comes to searching for the maximum compensation that you deserve for damages and losses.

Get in touch with Salazar & Velazquez for a free consultation. We deal with personal injury cases under a contingency contract, meaning that you will only pay if the case is solved successfully. We take care of all the costs upfront, that way you don’t have to pay anything until your case has been solved.
